integrity: An elementary proof establishes exact sumsets for all stated parameters. A self-contained Python 3 enumeration independently checks 864 finite parameter pairs; this is supplementary, not infinite validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the numerical semigroups generated by 6, 9, g, g+3 with g at least 13 and not divisible by 3 are covered. Their non-Weierstrass status is an attributed published input, not independently reproved. No full comparison was obtained for later revisions or every possible general additive-combinatorics equivalence; independent audit not performed.
title: Exact gap-sumsets of the minimal-multiplicity non-Weierstrass family
